people.imagined: Remembered: the hunter who sold herbs, on the coast road in 520, kneeling to set the first locust sapling into the earth, a basket of saplings beside him, sun through the first leaves.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the clan founder at forty-five, kneeling on a pale coast road at dawn and pressing earth round a young locust sapling with both hands. Face: a lean, brown, patient face with deep sun lines; soft dark eyes lowered on the sapling; thick straight brows; a hooked nose; a gentle half-smile; a short black-and-grey beard. Hair: black with grey, tied up in a knot under a plain straw hat tipped back. Body: tall, lean and long-armed, kneeling on one knee, shoulders bowed over the work with the stillness of a hunter in his back. Clothing: a mortal's long robe of soft undyed hemp-silk in pale moss green, clean and graceful, the crossed collar edged with a thin line of locust-yellow thread, wide sleeves tied back above the elbow with a green cord; a pouch of dried herbs at a plain sash; no ornament. Hands and objects: both hands settle soil round a slender sapling with four small bright leaves, the nails dark with earth; beside him a woven basket crowded with more saplings, roots wrapped in damp cloth. Background: a pale road running away toward blue mountains in drifting morning mist, old stumps either side where trees were cut, one crow on a stump. Light: soft spirit-light of first dawn from the upper left, a pale gold glow gathering on the sapling's leaves as though the tree were waking, a gentle rim light on his shoulders. Expression: a gentle, absorbed half-smile, eyes lowered and soft, the face of a man planting for people he will never meet. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint soft green and pale-yellow tint.

people.imagined: Mid-summer on the locust road. He walks slowly under the blossom with a pruning hook, stops at a tree, and says the name of the child who planted it. Yellow pollen is in his beard and he is smiling to the tree, not to anyone.
people.subject: The moment: standing under a flowering locust tree on a road in summer, one hand laid on its trunk, greeting it by name with a quiet smile. Face: a broad, deeply tanned old face, wide cheekbones, many lines; small kind dark eyes with a hidden watchfulness; heavy grey brows; a broad nose; a wide mouth in a soft smile; a thick white beard in which a dusting of pale-yellow locust pollen shows plainly, the first thing seen. Hair: white, thick, tied up in a knot with a jade-green ribbon and a plain pale jade pin. Body: broad, heavy-shouldered, with a hunter's stoop. Clothing: three layers of flowing silk, an inner robe of white, a middle robe of warm locust-flower yellow and an outer gauze robe of deep leaf green, the crossed collars showing at the neck; wide sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with small white locust blossoms in silver thread; a dark-green brocade sash hung with a green jade bead on a knotted tassel and a small jade pruning-hook charm. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long pruning hook with a bright blade; the left rests flat on the trunk. Power: a calm aura of pale blue-green water-qi rises from him, fine droplets and drifting petals circling slowly, the leaves of the tree turning toward his hand. Background: a long tunnel of locust trees heavy with white blossom, mist between the trunks, motes of pollen like lantern sparks, a distant range. Light: dappled moon-silver and gold spirit-light from the upper left, a soft green rim light. Expression: a quiet, stubborn waiting under a soft smile, the look of an old man who has spoken this tree's name every summer for fifty years. A faint cool blue-green tint.

people.imagined: Dawn at the foot of the road at the inn, in the doorway. He stands with a basket of dumplings under a cloth beside his ledger, a locust twig behind his ear, handing it to a guide with a stiff little lie about who it is for.
people.subject: The moment: in an inn doorway at dawn, handing a covered basket to a guide, a ledger tucked under his other arm. Face: a quiet, plain, gentle face; light brown skin; tired kind brown eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth that almost smiles; neat clean-shaven cheeks. Hair: black with a little grey, combed flat and tied in a small knot with a dark ribbon, a green locust twig tucked behind the right ear. Body: medium, slightly round-shouldered, a little forward as a man who bows to guests all day, elbows close to his ribs and feet together on the threshold. Clothing: a modest but graceful robe of dark-brown silk over a pale inner robe, two crossed collars, neat wide sleeves whose cuffs are bordered with a narrow band of locust-yellow embroidery, the only bright colour on him; a plain grey-green sash with a small jade button; no crown. Hands and objects: the right hand extends a round bamboo basket covered with a white cloth; the left arm clamps a thick bound ledger with blank grey covers. Power: a very faint thread of cool water-qi at his sleeves, barely a shimmer of dew. Background: the stone doorway of a road inn with a paper lantern still glowing, saddled horses, drifting dawn mist, and far down the road the first locust trees as dark upright shapes; a guide in a grey cloak waits just inside the frame. Light: pale pearl dawn light from the upper left, the lantern's warm glow on his cheek, a soft rim light. Expression: a careful, tender, slightly stiff look, the mouth closed on something unsaid and the tired eyes kind and watchful, hiding more than he shows. A faint moisture-blue cool tint.

people.imagined: Winter evening by a lamp. She is turning a thimble on its ribbon while listening to a visitor, a half-sewn fur cape across her knees, flour still white in the seams of her sleeves.
people.subject: The moment: seated by a lamp on a winter evening with a half-sewn fur cape across her knees, turning a thimble on a ribbon between her fingers while she listens. Face: a soft, round, kindly old face, deeply lined; pale brown skin; warm tired brown eyes; thin white brows; a small nose; a gentle closed mouth. Hair: thin white hair in a neat low bun held by a bone pin carved as a small bud. Body: small, plump and bent. Clothing: a mortal's gentle layered robe of soft dark-green quilted silk over a pale inner robe, two crossed collars, the borders embroidered with tiny locust-yellow blossoms; the cuffs of both sleeves still carry white flour caught in every seam, plainly visible, and she wears a clean pale sash. Hands and objects: the right hand turns a brass thimble hung on a faded red ribbon at her neck; the left holds a thick grey-brown fur cape with a half-finished hem and a needle; her small hands are swollen at the knuckles and the left forefinger has a tiny red needle-prick; a ball of grey thread rolls at her feet. Background: a warm shadowed room with a narrow bed and a patchwork quilt, a clay stove with a kettle just starting to steam, a paper window showing a thin line of snow outside, a pair of small mended boots by the door, faint motes of warm dust floating in the lamp's glow. Light: soft amber lamp-light from the lower left, as gentle as spirit-light, a faint moon-blue rim from the window. Expression: a patient, attentive, loving look, head tilted a little to listen and the soft old mouth ready to smile. A faint warm wood tint.

people.imagined: A loud afternoon at the dye works. He is about to bet on anything, a pair of dice in one yellow hand, laughing at a guest who owes him, arms yellow to the wrists.
people.subject: The moment: shaking a pair of dice in his cupped right hand, mid-laugh, ready to throw. Face: a broad, loud, red face; shiny cheeks; bright, quick, merry eyes with a shrewd glint; thick black brows; a big nose; a huge laughing mouth; a neat black moustache. Hair: black, in a loose knot held by a yellow-stained cord and a plain silver pin. Body: stocky, barrel-chested, restless. Clothing: a rich locust-yellow silk robe worn open over a white inner robe, two crossed collars, the borders embroidered in black thread with leaves and coins, wide sleeves pushed up in a thick roll; a black brocade sash with brass clasps and a red silk purse of dice-money swinging from it; both forearms and both hands dyed deep egg-yolk yellow to the elbow as if in gloves, with a few paler streaks, the main thing. Hands and objects: the right hand holds two dice up near his ear; the left rests on a copper vat rim, yellow-stained. Power: a faint shimmer of cool blue water-qi round his wrists, silver flecks running in the steam. Background: a stack of folded yellow cloth, long strips of dyed silk drying on racks in shades from lemon to amber, blurred dyers stirring vats in rising steam; a plain dice cup on an upturned barrel. Light: bright warm spirit-glow from the upper left, everything washed in yellow with mist and a soft golden rim light. Expression: a boisterous, red-faced laugh with the eyes screwed up and shrewd, a man enjoying the throw and already planning the next trick. A faint cool blue-silver tint in the shadows.

people.imagined: At a broken fence in the valley fields. He sniffs the air before speaking, then answers a question that was asked a beat ago, as if the words had to walk to him from far away.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a broken fence in the valley fields, sniffing the air with his head lifted, a slow dawning look. Face: a broad, sun-reddened, mild farmer's face; vague soft eyes with drooping lids; thick sandy-grey brows; a broad nose lifted in the sniff; a slightly open mouth; a few days of stubble. Hair: thin grey-brown, under a wide straw hat tipped back, a loose strand lifting in the breeze. Body: big, soft and slow, shoulders drooping. Clothing: a loose mortal's robe of soft brown silk-cotton, clean enough, with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, its hem bordered with a faded band of locust-yellow embroidery; a simple twisted cord for a sash; the right elbow carries one clumsy stitched seam in mismatched grey thread, a fault he has not noticed; one trouser leg is pulled down over a muddy boot while the other is hitched up. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a fence post that is leaning; the left rests on a hoe; his hands are large, cracked and slow, one thumb bound in a strip of clean linen. Background: beyond the fence three brown cattle have strayed across a half-planted row, a small boy runs after them in the blur, and the far hills are soft blue under a high summer sky shot with drifting mist and a few pale motes of light; a bucket lies where he left it in the grass. Light: warm, hazy, gold spirit-light from the upper left with a faint soft rim light along his hat and shoulder. Expression: a slow, dawning, half-puzzled look, the lids drooping and the mouth a little open, the face of a man who has smelled something and not yet worked out what. A faint cool green tint.

people.imagined: On the landing, watching a gull. He rolls on his feet like a deck, a laugh waiting at the lifted corner of his lip, deciding whether to sail by what the bird does.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a landing stage watching a gull, rocking on his heels like a deck, the scar at his lip lifting it into a permanent smirk. Face: a ruddy, weathered, craggy face; a white fish-hook scar at the left corner of the mouth that pulls it up so that he always looks about to laugh, big and plain; bright blue-grey eyes squinting skyward; sun-bleached thick brows; a crooked nose; salt-white stubble. Hair: grey, cropped, under a faded blue knit cap. Body: barrel-chested, short-legged, broad; he stands with his legs a little too wide and bent, as if on a rolling deck, shoulders swaying. Clothing: a flowing sea-blue robe of fine glossy silk with two crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied back with cords for rope-work, the borders embroidered with silver waves and small yellow locust blossoms; a knotted yellow silk neck-cloth; a deep-blue brocade sash with a short fishing knife in a polished sheath and a small white jade fish pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand shades his eyes; the left holds a coil of rope; his hands are big, red and knotted from rope. Power: a thin cool veil of blue water-qi runs along his sleeves, with a few bright droplets hanging in the air. Background: two small black boats with furled brown sails tied beside the stage, nets drying on poles, a single white gull on a post with its head cocked toward him, and a bank of low sea mist with a pale sun behind it. Light: cold silver sea-light from the upper left, mist-glow and a soft rim light. Expression: an amused, lopsided look, the scarred lip dragging the whole left cheek into a fold so that he seems always about to laugh at some private joke. A faint cool blue sea tint.

people.imagined: At the vats. Someone has told her what she must do. Her chin has come up before she says no, a yellow-dyed fringe falling over her eye and being tucked back behind an ear with a yellow hand.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a dye vat, her chin lifted, tucking a yellow-dyed lock of hair behind her ear with a yellow-stained hand. Face: a young, strong-boned, handsome face; clear brown skin; flashing dark eyes; straight firm brows; a straight nose; a mouth set to say no; a dimple. A loose strand of the yellow fringe has stuck to her damp cheek. Hair: black, with a thick fringe dyed bright locust-yellow at the front, plainly visible, the rest drawn up and pinned with a simple silver hairpin and a green ribbon. Body: strong, straight, shoulders squared. Clothing: a graceful robe of leaf-green silk worn over a white inner robe, two crossed collars, the borders embroidered with yellow locust blossoms, the wide sleeves bound back at the elbow with a yellow cord so that her hands are free; a sash of deep green brocade hung with one small jade bead; a few splashes of yellow dye across the front like painted petals; both hands and forearms stained deep yellow, ending in a sharp line at each elbow. Hands and objects: the right hand at the ear is yellow; the left grips a long wooden dye paddle. Power: a faint ripple of cool water-qi shimmers on the surface of the vat beside her and a few bright droplets float up past her sleeve. Background: a row of three copper vats with steam curling up, yellow and amber silk hung in long banners above them against a pale misty sky, a wooden ladder, and a blurred older man, her father, turning with a frown at the edge of the frame. Light: bright morning spirit-light from the upper left, steam glowing gold, a soft rim light on her cheek. Expression: a defiant look, chin lifted, the flashing eyes level and the mouth set to say no, a dimple showing despite herself. A faint cool water-blue shimmer.

people.imagined: Rehearsing, alone by the field wall: a question he has been told to ask. His voice breaks on the third word and he clears his throat like a man announcing himself.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight beside a field wall, chest out, clearing his throat after his voice has cracked, a blush rising. Face: a thin, eager, spotty young face; large earnest dark eyes; thin straight brows; a straight nose; a big Adam's apple; a mouth just closing; a little fuzz on the upper lip. Hair: black, uncombed, a cowlick, tied up with a new green ribbon. Body: tall and thin, all wrists and knees, hands too big. Clothing: a clean, new robe of fine dark-grey silk with two crossed collars, its shop creases still sharp, slightly short in the sleeves so that the wrists stick out; the hem and cuffs bordered with a thin line of locust-yellow cloud embroidery; a green sash tied too tight; a small wooden practice sword with a bound grip at his hip, tapping his leg. Hands and objects: both fists clenched in front, knuckles white, thin wrists bare. Background: a drystone field wall, young green barley in rows to the horizon, a distant mountain with a silver crown of cloud where a sect's gate waits, two crows on a fencepost watching him, a wild rose bush at the corner of the wall just in bud, and faint motes of light drifting in the morning mist. Light: bright, clear morning spirit-light from the upper left with a soft rim light on his ear and jaw. Expression: an earnest, flustered look, the throat bobbing and a blush climbing the cheeks, the eyes fixed bravely ahead on a gate he cannot see yet. A faint cool metal glint on the wooden sword.

people.imagined: Remembered: the bridge-builder in the flood, standing waist-deep in brown water with both arms round a stone pillar, his face lifted against the current, holding.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the bridge builder at fifty-five, waist-deep in a flood with both arms wrapped round a great stone pillar, his face lifted and set against the current. Face: a heavy, square, mason's face; skin tanned and grey with stone dust; thick, strong brows; narrow eyes fixed on something above the water; a wide nose; a clenched jaw; a short grey beard dripping. Hair: grey, wet, plastered, held by a soaked brown cord. Body: massive, thick-necked and very broad, braced chest-deep against the current with his head thrown back so that the tendons of the neck stand taut. Clothing: a long robe of heavy river-silt brown silk soaked dark, two crossed collars clinging to his chest, the wide sleeves shoved above the elbow to show a thick scarred forearm with veins standing like ropes; the borders embroidered with the pale lines of arches and waves; a wet brocade sash with a mason's chisel still hooked in it, dripping; no ornament but a small grey stone pendant. Hands and objects: both arms embrace the pillar, the hands locked on each other; dark water swirls to his chest with floating branches, and pushes a pale V of foam against him. Background: above him the pale stone underside of a great arch, a curtain of rain, and on the far side small dark figures on the bridge pointing; the water carries a drowned cart wheel and snapped branches. Light: pale silver storm-light from the upper left, a faint steady glow of earth-gold spirit-light gathering round the pillar and his hands where they hold. Expression: a locked jaw and narrowed eyes fixed upward, a face set hard as the stone he holds. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint earth-brown tint.

people.imagined: On the bridge at dusk. A cart creaks past and his eyes go to its axles before the driver's face; he stands heavy and slow in a coat the colour of dried clay, the seal of the bridge cord hanging at his chest.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the end of a stone bridge at dusk, looking down at the axles of a passing cart instead of the driver. Face: a heavy, square, slow face; skin ruddy brown; thick grey brows; small shrewd eyes lowered; a big flat nose; a wide, patient mouth turned down; a thick grey moustache; heavy jowls. Hair: grey and cropped, thinning, held under a small dark-bronze topknot crown. Body: heavy, square and slow, massive shoulders and thick forearms. Clothing: three heavy layers of river-silt silk, an inner robe of pale clay, a middle robe of grey-brown brocade and a long outer gauze robe the colour of dried clay, high round collars crossed at the neck; the wide sleeves and hem embroidered in earth-gold thread with twin arches and flowing river lines; a broad dark brocade sash hung with a heavy iron ring and a small round grey stone seal on a cord at his chest, its face smooth and unmarked. Hands and objects: huge mason's hands rest on the stone parapet, a heavy iron ring on the left thumb. Power: a slow, deep aura of earth-yellow qi settles round him like dust in lamplight, motes of gold drifting up from the stones under his palms. Background: the long grey arches of a paired stone bridge over a wide brown river, a line of laden ore carts, carters in blurred conical hats, and a small stone toll house with a red lantern glowing at the bridge's end. Light: low amber dusk spirit-light from the upper left, river mist, a soft rim light on his shoulders. Expression: a calm, heavy, calculating look, the small eyes lowered on the axles and the wide mouth turned down, as immovable as the parapet under his hands. A faint earth-yellow tint.

people.imagined: In the north toll house, copying figures into a book with ink on her sleeve, toll tokens on a cord at her wrist clicking. She has just crossed out a number, quietly.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk in the north toll house, a brush lifted over a book, a line just crossed out. Face: a neat, narrow, pale-brown face; steady grey-brown eyes; thin, straight grey brows; a fine straight nose; a calm mouth; fine lines. Hair: grey, smooth, drawn into a tight low bun with a plain jade-green pin. Body: slender, upright, composed. Clothing: a graceful grey silk robe with two crossed collars, an inner robe of pale river-silt, long wide sleeves bordered with fine earth-brown embroidery of twin arches; a narrow dark sash with a small jade clasp; the right sleeve cuff has a dark smear of ink, a big black blot; at her left wrist a cord strung with a dozen small round bronze tokens, each with a square hole, and a thin second cord at her right wrist carries a tiny brass key. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a brush; the left rests on an open book; her fingers are long and neat, a faint line of ink following the knuckle of the right forefinger. Power: a faint shimmer of green wood-qi in the brush tip and a few drifting motes of pale gold around her wrist cord. Background: a rack of thick unmarked books with coloured cord spines, a window showing grey river light and the corner of a bridge parapet, a small teapot steaming on a brazier, and on the desk a little dish with a handful of waived toll tokens set apart from the rest. Light: soft moon-grey window spirit-light from the upper left with a gentle warm glow from the brazier. Expression: a quiet, careful look, the mouth composed and the grey eyes steady, with a flicker of private kindness she is hiding behind the book. A faint earth tint.

people.imagined: Early morning at the bridge head, counting a cart's axles under his breath, an oilcloth coat dripping, eyes already on the next one.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a bridge head in drizzle, lips moving as he counts axles, a finger lifting for each. Face: a long, lean, hard face; skin weathered and sallow; thick dark brows drawn together; sharp restless eyes; a long straight nose; a thin mouth moving silently; a clean-shaven chin with a razor nick. Hair: black, combed back wet, in a tiny topknot with a bronze pin. Body: tall, thin and narrow-shouldered, hunched against the damp with his chin tucked in, one foot a little ahead as if ready to step into the road in front of a cart; a drop of water hangs from the tip of his nose. Clothing: a long toll-keeper's outer robe of oiled yellow-green silk, glossy and clean, worn over a good grey gauze robe and a pale inner robe with two crossed collars buttoned to the neck; narrow sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with fine bronze arch-lines; a belt of woven black cord with a small bronze scale-pan charm. Hands and objects: the right forefinger lifts and ticks off axles in the air; the left hand holds a small bound toll-book with blank covers. Power: a thin shimmer of cool earth-qi at his fingertips, a few gold motes jumping with each count. Background: a line of three laden carts stands in the rain with their drivers hunched, a heavy grey sky, a wet stone bridge with shining rails, a lantern burning beside the road; a second man in a darker coat with a brass-bound case, the assayer, stands blurred beyond the carts. Light: cold silver rain-light from the upper left with a faint lantern glow and a soft rim light. Expression: a tight, hungry look, the thin mouth working through a sum and the sharp eyes jumping from axle to axle with no patience for the driver's talk. A faint cool grey-green tint.

people.imagined: Coming up from a spring dive under the north bridge, river mud on his hair, grinning at the water with a cracked canine showing, his hand still cold from the crack.
people.subject: The moment: climbing out of a river after a dive, grinning back at the water, a cracked canine tooth showing. Face: a tanned, wet, cheerful square face; mud streaked on the cheek; easy brown eyes; thick brows; a broad nose; a wide grin with the left canine cracked in half, plain and visible. Hair: black, wet and plastered flat with silt, a tiny loose topknot. Body: strong, wide-shouldered, thick-armed, broad-chested. Clothing: a wet short robe of dark-brown silk clinging to the shoulders, two crossed collars loose at the neck, the borders embroidered with pale arch-lines and wave scrolls, split a finger's width along one shoulder seam where he hauled himself up, showing a pink scrape; a rope-and-silk sash with a lump of green river weed clinging to it; wet linen trousers; bare feet grey with silt to the ankle. Hands and objects: the right hand, bright with cold, is held half-open as though it has just touched stone; the left holds a rope whose thin braid trails into the water; water streams from his hair and fingertips. Power: a faint ring of earth-gold qi lingers at the right palm, a few pale motes rising with the water drops. Background: the dark stone base of the bridge pier rises out of green water, an iron ladder, a hint of a long vertical crack in the stone just visible at the waterline, and a small girl's head, his daughter, peering over the parapet far above. Light: bright silver river spirit-light from the upper left, water glints and a soft green rim light. Expression: an easy, careless grin over one shoulder, the cracked tooth showing and the eyes bright with cold water, a man pleased with the dive. A faint river-blue tint.

people.imagined: On a barge deck checking a hawser, strong hands running along it, laughing a sharp laugh like a rope snapping at a joke, forearms scarred with parallel lines.
people.subject: The moment: running a thick hemp rope through her hands on a barge deck, laughing suddenly. Face: a lean, strong, brown face with bright dark eyes and crow's-feet; straight brows; a short nose; a wide mouth open in a sharp laugh. Hair: dark brown with a streak of grey at the front, braided and wound in a tight crown held by a silver pin, a few loose curls stuck to her cheek with sweat. Body: wiry, strong-shouldered, feet apart on the wet deck, back straight, her laugh throwing her head back so that the corded muscle of her throat shows. Clothing: a flowing river-blue silk robe over a pale inner robe, two crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied back above the elbow with twisted cord, the borders embroidered in silver-grey with rope knots and wave scrolls; a sash of tarred-black brocade cord from which hangs a small silver marlinspike charm. Hands and objects: both forearms bear neat parallel pale scars from hemp burns, big and plain; her hands grip a thick rope. Power: a faint warm flicker of red fire-qi runs along the rope where her palms slide, tiny sparks lifting like fireflies. Background: coils of grey-gold hemp hawser as thick as a thigh, tied-up barges rocking on brown water, a rack of fresh twisted rope drying, and in the haze the long twin arches of the bridges; a heron stands on a bollard. Light: bright river-mist spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on her wet hair. Expression: a sudden, sharp, merry laugh, the head thrown back and the crow's-feet deep, bright eyes on the water. A faint warm hemp-brown tint.

people.imagined: Poling a ferry in high water, stooped like the pole she carries, shouting a price across the flood to a family on the far bank, in no hurry.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the back of a flat ferry, stooped over a long pole, shouting a price across brown flood water. Face: a sharp, hard, tanned face; narrow bright eyes; thin hard brows; a small sharp nose; a wide mouth open mid-shout. Hair: black, in a tight tail tied with a dark-blue silk ribbon, a pale scarf round the forehead. Body: tall, stooped like the pole she holds, long arms nearly straight on it and her back bent like a bow; bare feet gripping the wet planks, a fine mist of spray hanging round her. Clothing: a short layered robe of glossy dark-blue oiled silk with a stiff collar over a pale inner robe, two crossed collars at the neck, the wide sleeves tied back, the hem embroidered with silver waves and spattered with muddy water; a broad dark brocade sash with three small brass buckles; rolled trousers. Hands and objects: both hands wrap a long wooden pole; a fat small bag of coins swings at her sash. Background: across the water a far muddy bank with a huddle of three small figures, a mother with a bundle, a girl and a small boy sitting on a trunk wrapped in a blanket; a half-submerged fence post, drifting reeds, and a low silver sky with a sliver of yellow at the horizon, mist rolling along the flood. Light: cold pearl-grey spirit-light from the upper left with a pale glint along the pole and her shoulder. Expression: a hard, impatient stare and a mouth thrown open mid-shout, with nothing in the face for the huddle on the far bank but the price. A faint cool grey tint.

people.imagined: At his clerk's desk, counting a cart's tolls on his fingers while a driver talks, an ink smear on the tip of his pinched nose, watching a hand and not a face.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a clerk's table, counting on his fingers while someone talks to him out of frame. Face: a thin, pinched, pale face; narrow darting eyes; thin dark brows pulled in; a pinched nose with a black ink smear on the tip, plainly visible; a thin tight mouth. Hair: black, thin, oiled flat, in a tiny knot held by a small bronze pin. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, hunched over the table. Clothing: a neat grey-brown silk clerk's robe over a pale inner robe, a high collar and a second crossed collar at the neck, the sleeves bordered with fine earth-brown embroidery of tiny coins and arches, black cloth sleeve guards reaching to the elbow tied with thread; a narrow sash with a small abacus no longer than a hand hanging from it on a short jade bead cord. Hands and objects: the right hand counts on the left fingers; a brush with a split tip behind the ear; a book with blank columns open before him; his fingers are thin, nervous and ink-stained, the left forefinger raised mid-count with the thumb folded under. Background: through the toll window beside him a blurred cart and driver, a tray of copper coins sorted into three heaps, a hanging brass scale, a stack of tally sticks, a second book hidden half under the first, and a draught from the window stirring the paper and a few drifting motes of dust and pale gold light. Light: dull silver spirit-light from the upper left through the window, a thin cool rim light on his hunched shoulder. Expression: a suspicious, pinched look, the narrow eyes darting to the side and the thin mouth tight, counting the speaker's motives along with the coins. A faint earth-brown tint.

people.imagined: On the toll-house roof, tilting her head in quick jerks like a bird to count the carts below, freckles at the corners of her eyes, finger tapping the tally.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on a roof edge, head turned sharply sideways like a bird, counting carts below. Face: a small, bright, freckled face; freckles at the outer corner of each eye; quick dark eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a mouth open a little as she counts. Hair: brown, in two short braids tied with green silk cord and a tiny silver bell. Body: small, light, balanced on the balls of her feet. Clothing: a light, graceful robe of green-brown silk over a pale inner robe, two crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied back with ribbon, a small bird embroidered at the hem in plain brown thread and the borders embroidered with tiny arch-lines; a sash with a tally of cut sticks tied to it and a green jade bead; soft new boots; a sprig of green pinned at her collar. Hands and objects: the left hand grips the roof ridge; the right holds a pencil of charcoal and taps the roof tile in time. Background: below her the toll road with a thin line of small carts and oxen under drifting dust, the twin bridge arches silver in a bright pearly sky, swallows skimming the tiles beside her, a pigeon coop on the next roof, a ladder leaning against the eave, and a few motes of sunlight glittering in the air. Light: bright silver noon spirit-light from the upper left, tiles glowing pale beneath her, a soft rim light on her braids. Expression: a quick, busy, trusting look with the lips parted as she counts, the bright eyes fixed on the road below and a small frown of concentration. A faint earth-brown tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the exile leader on the road to Phong Lâm, a family's worth of people behind him and swallows overhead, looking back once at the land he will not name.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the clan's leader at forty-five on an exile's road, a small wooden box carried in both hands, looking back over his shoulder with a calm unreadable face as swallows fly over. Face: a long, grave, scholarly face; pale skin, tired; deep dark eyes; straight thick brows; a high-bridged nose; a firm closed mouth; a short black beard with a streak of grey. Hair: black, tied in a scholar's knot with a simple black ribbon and a plain dark-jade pin. Body: tall, thin, upright, a weight in the shoulders; behind him a line of small figures with bundles on their backs, two children and an old woman on a donkey, drawn tiny. Clothing: a long robe of dark blue-grey silk, once very fine and now carefully mended with matching thread, with two crossed collars and wide sleeves that fall in long folds, the borders embroidered in pale silver with small swallows and clouds; a plain dark sash with a black bamboo fan tucked in and a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small flat dark lacquered box with a dull brass catch close to his chest; three small swallows circle over his head. Background: the road is pale and dusty and runs to a thin horizon of low hills in blue mist; dozens of swallows wheel against the grey-gold sky and one lands on the box; a dead tree stands at the roadside with a single green shoot. Light: grey-gold moonlit dusk from the upper left, a soft silver rim light along his cheek and shoulder. Expression: a grave, patient look over the shoulder, the dark eyes tired and unblinking and the closed mouth giving nothing away, a man who will not forget. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: In his study under the swallow's nest, brush lifted over a sheet, answering a letter in the clan's formal hand while two swallows chatter above the door.
people.subject: The moment: seated upright at a low desk in a study under a swallow's nest, a fine brush lifted over a sheet. Face: a thin, upright, refined old face, skin pale and fine; sharp, intelligent dark eyes with a haughty lift; thin white brows; a long straight nose; a thin dry mouth; a long thin white beard to the chest. Hair: white, in a tight topknot crowned with a small silver guan and a black lacquer pin. Body: thin, very upright, narrow-shouldered, sitting with the stillness of a man trained from childhood, his back not touching the chair and his wrist raised to keep the sleeve off the paper. Clothing: three layers of flowing blue-grey silk, an inner robe of pale grey, a middle robe of deep blue-grey brocade and an outer gauze robe whose seams are re-stitched so finely that the stitching reads as embroidery, with tiny swallows and clouds in matching silver-grey thread along the borders and hem; a high crossed collar; a black brocade sash hung with a white jade pendant and tassel. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a long brush; the left holds a black bamboo fan painted with small swallows; his fingers are long and pale, a callus on the side of the middle finger and a single ink stain; on the desk a stone ink block. Power: a cool, still aura of green wood-qi gathers about him, fine leaf-shaped motes drifting slowly up from the brush. Background: a study with a carved lintel, a low window of white paper with the shadow of a pine branch, a shelf of identical black-covered letter boxes, a small bronze incense burner with a thin line of smoke, and above the door the mud cup of a swallow's nest with a chick's beak showing. Light: soft moon-silver spirit-light from the upper left and a gentle glow from the incense. Expression: a proud, still, composed look, the dark eyes lifted with a faint haughtiness and the dry mouth patient and thin. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: At a classroom door, a child's slate under his arm, bending to a small pupil with ink-stained cuffs, with his soft voice and a gentle hidden lie about to leave his lips.
people.subject: The moment: bending slightly at a classroom door, a slate under one arm, listening to a small child. Face: a soft, kind, thin face; warm brown eyes; thin gentle brows; a straight nose; a small kind mouth; a few early lines. Hair: black, tied loosely in a scholar's knot with a blue-grey ribbon and a plain silver pin. Body: slender, slightly stooped, leaning to the child's height with the stoop of a man who has bent to children for twenty years. Clothing: a flowing blue-grey silk robe over a pale inner robe, two crossed collars, wide sleeves whose borders are embroidered with small silver swallows, both cuffs stained with black ink, plainly visible; the left sleeve has a long grey smear of chalk; a narrow sash with a small white jade pendant; a tiny paper swallow pinned to his collar. Hands and objects: a child's small slate with a drawing of a bird under the left arm; the right hand holds a brush; a child's hand tugs his sleeve. Power: a faint cool breath of green wood-qi, a few small motes floating around the child and himself. Background: behind him the school door opens onto a room with rows of low desks, morning light slanting across slates, a wooden swallow carved over the lintel, a girl with a plait waiting in the doorway, and a pot of chrysanthemums on the sill. Light: soft pearl morning spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle silver rim light on his hair. Expression: a gentle, patient look, the head tilted to the child's height and the soft mouth smiling a little, a trace of something concealed behind the kindness. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: At the swallow nests under the eaves, smiling up with feathers pinned in her hair, mulberry pollen in the creases of her smile, a thin account-book under one arm.
people.subject: The moment: standing under the eaves of a hall, smiling up at a row of swallows' nests. Face: a soft, warm, round face; kind dark eyes; thin brows; a small nose; a wide gentle smile with yellow pollen in the smile creases; laugh lines. Hair: grey-black, in a loose bun with three small swallow feathers pinned in beside a plain jade hairpin. Body: plump, comfortable. Clothing: a clean, graceful robe of pale-green silk with a blue-grey outer gauze robe, two crossed collars, the plain brown border embroidered with small silver swallows, the faded blue-grey pockets, and sleeves pushed up showing sun-brown forearms; a soft sash and a thin string of wooden beads. Hands and objects: one hand lifted toward a nest; the other holds a thin book of accounts against her hip with a stub of pencil tied to it by a string; her hands are broad, soft and warm-looking. Background: overhead the eaves of a mud-brick hall hold eleven mud nests in a row, each with a small dark opening; swallows dart in and out in the mist; below, the earth is swept clean in a neat circle, and a small ladder leans against the wall beside a pail of water; a few motes of pollen glitter in the air like tiny lanterns. Light: warm pearl-gold spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on her round cheek and the feathers in her hair. Expression: a wide, gentle, contented smile with the laugh lines deep and the head tipped back, delighted by the nests. A faint soft green.

people.imagined: In the maple grove, calling a stranger friend with a flash of gold tooth, both sleeves stained with sap, as he lays an arm round a sap-boiler's shoulder.
people.subject: The moment: laying a friendly arm round a stranger's shoulder in a maple grove, grinning wide so that a gold tooth flashes. Face: a round, shiny, jovial face; clever small eyes; thick brows; a flat nose; a big grin with a gold front tooth on the upper left, plainly drawn. Hair: black, oiled, in a topknot with a red cord and a small gold pin. Body: stocky, hearty, leaning forward in a confident, shoulder-clapping posture, his big belly pushed out over the sash. Clothing: a rich maple-red silk robe worn over a cream inner robe, two crossed collars, wide sleeves heavy with sticky amber sap, the amber stains shiny and dark, the borders embroidered in gold thread with maple leaves and coins; a broad brocade sash with a copper clasp shaped like a leaf and a polished amber pendant; fingers ringed with sticky amber. Hands and objects: the right arm round a blurred shoulder; the left holds a small amber-filled jar. Power: a faint warm glow of green wood-qi stirs the leaves near him, a few golden sap-motes drifting. Background: a slope of maples blazing red and gold, wooden sap buckets hung on trunks, a thin trail of smoke from a boiling shed, and the blurred sap-boiler, a thin widow in a faded headcloth, looking down; fallen leaves cover the path. Light: warm amber autumn spirit-light from the upper left with a soft golden rim light on his round cheek. Expression: a hearty, gold-toothed grin with the small eyes shrewd and gleaming, the friendliness of a man who is already measuring your pockets. A faint warm amber tint.

people.imagined: At a table with a tea cup, her left hand held in her lap, five rings on it glittering whenever she moves; she looks bored at the old name on the wall.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a table, her left hand lifted off the table edge to show five rings, a small cold smile. Face: a sharp, handsome, powdered face; cold narrow eyes; thin arched brows; a thin nose; a thin red mouth. Hair: black with grey, piled high with silver pins and a jade comb. Body: slim, upright, poised, sitting at an angle with her right hand carefully out of sight and her chin lifted a little. Clothing: a deep jade-green silk robe with silver edging over a white inner robe, two crossed collars and a high neck, the wide sleeves embroidered with silver swallows and clouds that she wears as a house's old finery; a jade bracelet on the right wrist; a thin silver chain at the neck; a brocade sash. Hands and objects: the left hand has five rings on five fingers, a red stone, a green stone, a plain band, a twisted band and a pearl, large in the lower frame, held out like an object on display with the wrist bent; the right hand is bare and hidden under the table. Background: three pale rectangles on the wall where something once hung, a lacquered table with a single teacup steaming faintly, a half-empty sideboard with a gap in a row of silver spoons, and a kitchen girl in the doorway in the blur, her head bowed; thin mist and a few cold motes of light in the dim room. Light: cool moon-silver spirit-light from the upper left glinting on the rings, a pale rim light on her powdered cheek. Expression: a bored, cold, small smile with the narrow eyes half-lidded, the face of a woman showing off her wealth and counting what is missing. A faint green tint.

people.imagined: Midway through a lesson, a stick of chalk snapping in his fingers, white dust on the left sleeve, bench creaking beneath him, smiling anyway.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a blackboard in the middle of a lesson, a piece of chalk snapping in his hand, a small startled smile. Face: a mild, thin, kind face; light brown eyes; soft brows; a long nose; a modest smile; a smear of chalk on the cheek. Hair: brown, tied back with a blue-grey ribbon. Body: tall, lanky, slightly stooped. Clothing: a clean flowing blue-grey silk robe over a pale inner robe, two crossed collars, the sleeves a little short and the borders embroidered with small silver swallows, chalk dust thick across the left sleeve and one elbow re-stitched in careful matching thread; a narrow sash with a leather satchel at his hip and a third whole piece of chalk sticking out of it; a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand holds two halves of broken chalk delicately, as if trying to join them; behind him a bench with a cracked leg propped on a bundle of folded cloth. Background: a plain board wall with simple birds sketched in white chalk, rows of low benches with one propped on a book, slates stacked in a corner, dust motes glowing in a shaft of window light like drifting sparks, and a small wooden crane on the teacher's table. Light: soft pearl spirit-light from the upper left, a gentle silver rim light on his hair. Expression: a small, startled, rueful smile, the brows lifted and the eyes soft, a mild man caught out by his own clumsiness. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: Sitting with her back as stiff as her grandfather's, looking straight at whoever is speaking, a page of her cousin's copying in her hand, deciding whether to praise or tear it.
people.subject: The moment: sitting bolt upright, holding a page of writing, looking straight at the viewer. Face: a thin, bright, handsome young face; direct dark eyes; strong straight brows; a straight nose; a firm young mouth. Hair: black, in a tight high knot with a swallow-feather pin of white jade and a thin silver ribbon. Body: slim and stiff-backed, chin level; her back is a ruler-straight copy of her grandfather's, shoulders pinned back, feet flat, her head cocked fractionally to one side as she measures a person. Clothing: a crisp, graceful robe of fine blue-grey silk over a white inner robe, a high collar with a second crossed collar showing, wide sleeves falling in long folds, the borders embroidered in silver with small swallows and cloud scrolls; a narrow sash tied in a flat square knot, hung with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a sheet of paper with drawn black marks between thumb and forefinger as if about to tear it, the knuckles white; the left hand lies flat on her knee. Power: a thin cool shimmer of green wood-qi at her fingertips, barely more than a breath, a few pale leaf-shaped motes. Background: a study with a painted screen of reeds and flying geese, a low desk with a half-burnt page curled in a dish, an ink stone, a brush rack, the shadow of a swallow on the paper wall, and a small brazier smoking quietly. Light: soft moon-silver spirit-light from the upper left, a thin bright rim light on her jaw and shoulder. Expression: an unblinking, level stare with the chin up and the mouth shut hard, the look of a girl who has already decided what she will be and is judging whether the viewer is of any use. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: Alone at night with a stack of sealed letters, a pen clenched in her teeth, bitten nails on the paper, ink on her lips, noticing something wrong with a handwriting.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a letter at night, a pen clamped in her teeth, eyes wide. Face: a pale, thin, worried face; wide dark eyes; thin brows pulled up; a small nose; ink stains on her lips. Hair: black, tied up loosely with a blue-grey ribbon, a few strands falling. Body: thin and hunched, bent so low that the light shows the down on her cheek; her left foot tucked under her and the right toe tapping nervously. Clothing: a neat, soft robe of blue-grey silk over a pale inner robe, two crossed collars, loose wide sleeves pushed past the elbow with a smear of ink along the left forearm, the borders embroidered with tiny silver swallows; a thin sash with a small jade bead. Hands and objects: both hands hold a thin letter up to the lamp, the nails bitten to the quick; a second letter lies unfolded under her elbow and a third, sealed with plain wax, by the lamp. Power: a faint cool thread of blue water-qi trembles in the lamp flame, barely visible. Background: a dark room with a heap of letters tied in bundles, an open chest, a paper window with a thin moon in it, a half-empty teacup gone cold, and on the wall her own shadow huge and still; thin mist and a few drifting motes of silver light. Light: warm lamp-light from the lower right mixed with cold moon spirit-light, a pale rim light on her cheek. Expression: wide, frightened, hungry eyes, the brows pulled up and the pen clamped hard in her teeth, the look of someone reading something twice to be sure. A faint blue-grey tint.

people.imagined: Remembered: the paddy-clearer at the first great harvest, standing knee-deep in gold rice with a sickle held loosely, content.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the first harvest-bringer at fifty, standing in a field of ripe gold rice, a sickle held loosely at his side, smiling. Face: a broad, kind, sun-weathered face; warm brown eyes crinkled; thick brows; a short nose; a wide easy smile; a short grey beard. Hair: grey, in a topknot under a conical straw hat pushed back, its brim bent and bleached pale by sun. Body: stout, strong and relaxed, standing with his weight on one leg, the sickle hanging point down. Clothing: a mortal's graceful robe of soft gold-brown silk-cotton, clean, with two crossed collars and sleeves rolled above muscled forearms freckled with mud, a stitched line of blue thread at the shoulder where a seam was reset; the borders embroidered in pale green with rice-ear sprigs; a sash of twisted rice-straw cord; rolled trousers muddy to the knee; bare feet deep in the golden stalks. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a bright curved sickle; the left a handful of rice heads. Background: a wide plain of heavy golden rice heads bending in rows to a flat horizon in soft mist, a few harvesters in the distance bent double, a grey heron standing in a flooded corner, a pale sky with soft cloud banks, a stack of sheaves to one side, and a scatter of golden motes drifting from the grain. Light: warm gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a soft glowing rim light along his hat and shoulder. Expression: a wide, easy, contented smile, the eyes crinkled, a man pleased with the field and the people it will feed. The whole picture faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A faint gold-green tint.
